what: the hilt of a broken Norse sword with only a stump of blade left. The blade is snapped off short: what remains is a broad piece of dull iron no longer than the grip, which ends in a ragged slanting break with three jagged teeth, like torn metal; there is no point and no upper blade anywhere in the picture. Below the stump the hilt is whole: a short thick straight crossguard of tarnished bronze, a grip wrapped in worn dark green leather, and a broad low tarnished bronze pommel with five rounded lobes like a row of knuckles.
colours: Dull dark grey iron stump with a paler grey broken face; tarnished dark golden-brown bronze guard and pommel; a worn dark green grip.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the pommel at the bottom left and the jagged broken end of the blade stump pointing to the top right; it is short and sits in the middle of the picture.
must_show: only a short jagged stump of blade
diagonal, broken end at top right

what: a shepherd's sling laid out at full length, described from the bottom left to the top right. At the bottom left, a small finger loop tied in the end of a cord. From the loop runs one thick braided cord of dark brown wool, as thick as a finger, in a gentle sagging curve. In the very middle of the picture the cord joins a pouch: one broad diamond-shaped pad of dark leather, four times as wide as the cord, cupped like a shallow dish, and sitting in the dish is one smooth round pale grey river pebble a third as wide as the pouch. From the far side of the pouch a second thick braided cord, the same as the first, runs on in a gentle curve to the top right, where it ends in one fat knot. The two cords and the pouch between them make one long line; the pouch with its stone is the widest and boldest part, in the middle.
colours: Dark chestnut-brown leather pouch and dark brown braided wool cords, darker in the creases; one smooth pale grey stone.
pose: Laid out on a diagonal from the bottom left corner to the top right corner, in a shallow S-curve, the pouch with its stone in the middle of the picture.
must_show: a thick cord at each side
a broad leather pouch in the middle
one smooth pale stone in the pouch

what: a father's big clenched right fist, by itself, a fist and nothing more: four thick fingers curled tight with four big square knuckles in a row facing the viewer, the thumb folded across the front of the fingers, broad and strong. The fist ends neatly at the wrist inside a rolled-up shirt cuff of plain white linen, which is the bottom edge of the thing: nothing continues beyond the cuff. It is painted seriously, like a study of a hand by an old master, not a cartoon.
colours: Weather-beaten light tan skin with warm brown shading between the fingers; a plain off-white rolled linen cuff.
pose: The fist is seen from the front and a little to one side, knuckles to the upper right, the cuff at the bottom left, floating by itself.
must_show: four big knuckles facing the viewer
ends in a rolled white cuff at the wrist

what: the broken-off top end of a barbed bone spear: a thick spearhead carved from pale sea-beast bone, with a sharp point and, down each of its two edges, three big backward-pointing barbs like the teeth of a harpoon; its base is bound with many turns of dark sinew cord to a short thick stump of dark wooden shaft, which ends in long ragged splinters where the spear snapped.
colours: Chalk grey-white bone with dull grey-brown in the hollows, never gold; dark brown sinew binding; a dark brown shaft with paler splinters.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the splintered broken end at the bottom left corner and the bone point at the top right corner.
must_show: barbed bone spearhead with big backward barbs

what: the great war spear of the best of the Greeks, too heavy for other men: a very long straight shaft of ash wood, very thick, and at its top a very large long leaf-shaped spearhead of bronze with a strong raised rib, joined to the shaft by a long bronze socket with two raised rings; a wide band of the shaft at the middle is bound in pale worn leather for a grip; a heavy bronze spike shoes the butt.
colours: A dark brown ash shaft, darkened with age and handling; the head, socket and butt-spike are bright warm yellow-brown bronze like a polished brass door-knob; a pale buff leather grip.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: pale leather grip band at the middle

what: the jewelled spear of the Japanese creator gods: a very long straight thick shaft lacquered glossy blue-black and studded from end to end with a single row of big round jewels, white pearls and pale green jade beads by turns, each set in a gold ring; at its top a broad straight double-edged blade of bright silver steel, long and leaf-pointed, rising from a gold collar shaped like an open flower; the blade is crusted near its tip with white sea salt.
colours: A glossy blue-black shaft; white pearls and pale green jade in yellow gold rings; a bright silver-white blade with a white crust of salt; a gold collar.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: dark shaft studded with a row of big round jewels

what: an Irish hero's terrible barbed spear made from the bone of a sea monster: a very long straight thick shaft of pale grey-white bone, knobbed at intervals like a spine, and at its top a long bone spearhead with a sharp point and, down each of its two sides, a row of four big barbs that point backward towards the butt, like the head of a harpoon or a fish's backbone; the barbs are thick and bold. The middle of the shaft is wound with dark sea-green sharkskin for a grip.
colours: Chalk grey-white bone with dull grey-brown in the hollows, never gold; a dark sea-green grip band.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: the whole spear is pale bone
long head with rows of big backward-pointing barbs down both sides

what: an Irish warrior's red spear whose wounds never heal: a very long straight thick shaft lacquered deep blood-red from end to end, ringed with four narrow gold bands; at its top a long narrow spearhead of dark steel with a bright crimson sheen along both edges, as if the steel itself were stained red, rising from a gold socket; a gold cap shoes the butt.
colours: A deep dark red shaft; yellow gold bands, socket and cap; a dark steel head with bright crimson edges.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.

what: the spear of the father of the Norse gods: a very long straight thick shaft of ash wood stained very dark, nearly black; at its top a long narrow spearhead of bright steel shaped like a tall thin diamond, with a row of big angular runes cut down its middle and filled with gold, rising from a long steel socket that has two short pointed lugs, one each side, like small wings; the top quarter of the shaft below the socket is bound with a spiral of gold wire.
colours: A very dark grey-brown shaft, nearly black; a bright silver-white steel head with yellow gold runes; a spiral of yellow gold wire.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: long bright head with gold runes on it
two small lugs on the socket
gold wire spiral below the head

what: a Spartan king's spear, a dory: a very long straight thick shaft of ash wood; at its top a plain leaf-shaped spearhead of dark grey iron; at its other end, the butt, a second, different point: a long heavy four-sided spike of bronze, as long as the spearhead, on a bronze socket, the lizard-killer. So it has a grey iron head at one end and a bronze spike at the other. A band of dark leather is wrapped round the middle of the shaft, and the wood is scarred with nicks.
colours: A weathered mid-brown ash shaft; a dark grey iron head with a bright edge; a warm golden-brown bronze butt-spike; a dark brown leather grip.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the bronze butt-spike at the bottom left corner and the iron head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: grey iron leaf-shaped head at the top right
long bronze spike on the butt at the bottom left
dark leather grip at the middle

what: the spear of Rome's founder, which took root where it struck: a very long straight thick shaft of dark cornel wood with the bark still on its lower part; at its top a broad triangular spearhead of bronze on a short bronze socket; the middle of the shaft is wrapped in a wide band of shaggy grey wolf fur tied with a thong; and from the lowest part of the shaft, near the butt, sprout two short living twigs with a few bright green leaves, lying close along the wood.
colours: A dark brown shaft; a warm golden-brown bronze head; a band of shaggy grey fur; a few fresh green leaves.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: band of shaggy grey fur at the middle
a few green leaves sprouting near the butt

what: a Roman soldier's pilum, the heavy javelin of the legions: the lower half is a thick straight shaft of dark wood; at the middle the wood swells into a square pyramid-shaped wooden block bound with two iron rivets; out of the top of that block comes a long straight shank of dark iron, bold and as thick as a finger, as long as the wooden half, ending in a small sharp four-sided pyramid point. The point and the top hand's length of the shank are blackened, darker than the rest, as if scorched. A short iron spike shoes the butt.
colours: A dark brown wooden lower half; a dark grey iron shank; a soot-black point; nothing bright.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: wooden lower half, long iron shank for the upper half
a square block where wood meets iron
must_not_show: wooden shaft all the way to the head

what: an Irish sun-god's spear, so hot it must be kept in water: a very long straight thick shaft of dark wood, its top quarter charred black; at its top a long spearhead with wavy edges like a tongue of flame, of iron glowing with heat, white-hot at the point, bright yellow in the middle and deep orange where it meets the socket; the socket is dark bronze with three raised rings. The heat is in the metal itself, with only a few small tongues of flame licking close along the edges of the head, joined to it.
colours: A dark brown shaft charred black near the top; a dark bronze socket; a spearhead glowing white, yellow and deep orange.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: dark shaft charred near the head

what: the sea-god's trident, all of one sea-dark metal: a very long straight thick shaft of dark blue-green bronze, ringed with raised bands, and at its top a broad crosspiece from which rise three thick prongs side by side like a fork, the middle one straight and a little longer, the two outer ones curving outward and then up; each prong ends in a broad barbed arrow-shaped point. A few pale barnacles crust the shaft near the butt, and the butt ends in a ball.
colours: Dark sea-blue-green metal, the colour of deep water, with pale turquoise highlights along the edges; a few chalk-white barnacles.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the shaft at the bottom left corner and the three prongs at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture, all three prongs inside the picture.
must_show: three thick barbed prongs side by side
dark blue-green metal, shaft and head alike

what: the Vel, a Tamil war-god's lance: a long straight thick shaft of gilded metal ringed with raised bands, and at its top one enormous spearhead of shining golden bronze, very broad, shaped like a wide leaf or a flame of a candle: a round full belly at the bottom, as wide as a third of the head's length, drawing in to a long sharp point at the top, with a raised rib down the middle. The head is a quarter of the whole weapon's length and far broader than an ordinary spearhead. It sits on a collar shaped like a lotus bud, and its edges shine with a warm orange glow of heat.
colours: The great head is brilliant golden bronze with white highlights and a warm orange shine at the edges; the shaft is rich yellow gold.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the pole at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole length inside the picture.
must_show: enormous broad teardrop-shaped golden head with a full round belly

what: an ancient holy war hammer that holds a piece of the dawn, a grim serious weapon scarred by long use: a long straight haft of grey steel, its lower half wrapped in old cream-white leather straps; at its top a great hammer head of battle-worn grey steel, a thick heavy block with two broad flat striking faces, dented at the corners, its edges bound with bands of dull old gold engraved with small rays. Set in the middle of the side of the head that faces the viewer is a round disc of golden crystal, as wide as the head is tall, glowing with warm yellow-white light like the rising sun. The glow stays inside the disc.
colours: Battle-worn silver-grey steel head and haft with dark grey shadows; dull rich old gold bands; a disc glowing warm yellow-white; cream-white leather straps.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the butt of the handle at the bottom left corner and the head at the top right corner, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: grey steel block head with two striking faces
a glowing golden disc set in the side of the head

what: the thunder-god's war hammer, famous for its short handle. It is a hammer with two blunt flat ends, not an axe: it has no blade and no cutting edge. The head is an enormous block of dark iron, twice as long as it is tall, with slightly sloping ends, its side carved with deep interlaced Norse knotwork whose grooves are lined with silver. A broad band of bright bronze is clamped round each end of the head, so the head is grey in the middle and bronze at both ends. The handle is plainly too short for it: thick, no longer than the head itself, wrapped in dark brown leather, ending in a plain round iron knob. The head is as big as the handle is long.
colours: Dark charcoal-grey iron head with bright silver in the knotwork grooves; a broad band of bright warm yellow-brown bronze, like a polished brass door-knob, round each end of the head; a dark brown leather handle; a dark iron knob.
pose: It lies on a diagonal, the knob at the butt of the short handle at the bottom left and the great block head at the top right, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: a huge blocky iron head with two blunt flat ends
a bronze band round each end of the head
a handle no longer than the head, ending in a knob
